sdk-quickstart.summary: For this tagged release, the high-level server is McpServer from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/mcp.js. StdioServerTransport is exported by @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/server/stdio.js. Zod supplies input schemas. registerTool accepts a name, a configuration containing a raw input-schema shape, and a handler returning content. Connect the server to the transport asynchronously. The example uses text content blocks. Inspect installed declarations for complete signatures; this summary is not a substitute for typechecking.

server-validation.summary: In this release, tool discovery converts the registered input schema to JSON Schema and exposes annotations. Call handling validates arguments before invoking the tool callback. A failed parse produces the SDK InvalidParams protocol error. Exceptions from the callback become an isError tool result. These are different failure paths; test the public client-observable behavior instead of assuming all failures use one response form.
